description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot configuration class 'OpenApiConfig' that sets up OpenAPI (Swagger) documentation for the project. It dynamically derives the server URL from X-Forwarded headers to support proxy/previews, providing detailed API metadata including title, description, contact, and license information.

classes.name: OpenApiConfig
classes.description: Configuration class that sets up OpenAPI documentation with dynamic server URL handling based on forwarded headers.

methods.name: customOpenAPI
methods.description: Creates and returns an OpenAPI object with API info and optional server URL derived from proxy headers.

methods.name: deriveServerUrlFromForwardedHeaders
methods.description: Extracts forwarding headers from the current HTTP request to construct an external server URL if available.
